caption:
You check your bank balance every day.
You check your pipeline once a month.

Run this every Monday instead. One number per system, fifteen minutes:

1. Acquisition: cost per booked appointment, by source
2. Conversion: average response time on your last 10 leads
3. Operations: leads sitting untouched right now
4. Retention: past customers touched this week

Name one owner per number. Same order, every week. The systems you don't check are the ones losing you money.

DM TOOLS
#ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #SpeedToLead #CRMForContractors #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Carousels lead saves/depth for B2B authority content in 2026 benchmarks, and this ships an unclaimed weekly-cadence accountability ritual (one owner, one number, per system) distinct from every prior self-score, diagnostic, triage, ladder, aging-bucket, matrix, and segmentation framework already covered.
